title: Blackberry Vinegar Recipe
ldInstructionsRaw: Weigh the blackberries, then add to a large container with an equal quantity of vinegar. Allow the mixture to steep 7–10 days, covered, at room temperature or refrigerated. Strain the mixture, reserving the liquid
Add the liquid to a saucepan with 450g of sugar per 700ml of liquid. Bring to the boil, then cook at a boil for 8-10 minutes
Transfer to sterilized bottles and enjoy!
